cards.label: A: purpose unclear
cards.detail: Card A: “When will this happen?” It expresses concern but does not identify the application or information requested. Help make the purpose specific.

cards.label: B: specific verification question
cards.detail: Card B: “About my fictional accreditation application: has it been received, and how can I verify the status and next step?” It names the purpose and asks for unconfirmed information.

cards.label: C: guessed cause and requirement
cards.detail: Card C: “A document must be lost; I will submit everything again.” It guesses the cause and requirement. Waiting does not prove loss. First ask whether an item needs verification, exactly which item and how to provide it safely through the appropriate channel. Practice uses no real documents.

fil.title: Aling card ang may malinaw na tanong?
fil.caption: Kathang-isip na pagsasanay · walang totoong dokumento

cards.label: A: kulang sa tiyak na pakay
cards.detail: Card A: “Kailan pa ba ito?” May pag-aalala, ngunit hindi malinaw kung aling aplikasyon o impormasyon ang hinihingi. Tulungang tukuyin ang pakay.

cards.label: B: malinaw na verification question
cards.detail: Card B: “Tungkol po sa kathang-isip na aplikasyon ko sa akreditasyon: natanggap na po ba ito, at paano ko matitiyak ang status at susunod na hakbang?” Tiyak ang pakay at humihingi ng impormasyong hindi pa nakukumpirma.

cards.label: C: hula sa sanhi at requirement
cards.detail: Card C: “Tiyak na may nawawalang dokumento; ipapasa ko na lang muli lahat.” Hula ang sanhi at requirement. Hindi patunay ng pagkawala ang paghihintay. Itanong muna kung may item na kailangang tiyakin, ano mismo iyon at paano ligtas na magbigay sa tamang channel. Walang totoong dokumentong gagamitin sa pagsasanay.

en.title: Listen, repeat and clarify
en.caption: The response establishes neither approval nor a missing document. Constructive follow-up does not guarantee an answer, accreditation, a benefit or an appointment.

cards.label: Before · unconfirmed assumption
cards.detail: Before: Demi thinks, “Perhaps it is approved because it has been a long time.” She has not confirmed this.

cards.label: After · response in the fictional conversation
cards.detail: After: in the fictional conversation, the appropriate contact says the application is still being reviewed and no date can be given. This is the example’s response, not a national procedure or timetable.

fil.title: Makinig, ulitin at linawin
fil.caption: Walang natiyak na approval o kulang na dokumento sa sagot. Ang maayos na follow-up ay hindi garantiya ng sagot, akreditasyon, benepisyo o appointment.

cards.label: Bago · hindi pa kumpirmadong palagay
cards.detail: Bago: iniisip ni Demi na “baka aprubado na dahil matagal na.” Hindi niya pa ito nakukumpirma.

cards.label: Pagkatapos · sagot sa kathang-isip na usapan
cards.detail: Pagkatapos: sa kathang-isip na usapan, sinabi ng tamang contact na sinusuri pa ang aplikasyon at wala pang petsang maibibigay. Ito ang sagot sa halimbawa, hindi pambansang proseso o takdang oras.

en.title: Plan a realistic next contact
en.caption: If there is no date, ask how to agree on an appropriate next contact. If an item needs verification, clarify the exact item and proper method before acting. If responsibility is unclear, ask the local health team to help identify the contact. There is no single prescribed interval for everyone. Use no private details or patient record.

fil.title: Pumili ng makatotohanang susunod na contact
fil.caption: Kung walang petsa, itanong kung paano magkakasundo sa angkop na susunod na contact. Kung may item na kailangang tiyakin, linawin ang eksaktong item at tamang paraan bago kumilos. Kung hindi malinaw kung sino ang responsable, humingi ng tulong sa lokal na health team upang matukoy ang contact. Walang iisang itinakdang pagitan para sa lahat. Walang pribadong detalye o patient record.

cards.label: napagkasunduang susunod na contact o channel
